fields.name: chakra
fields.description: Filter by chakra association, case-insensitive. Valid values: Root, Sacral, Solar Plexus, Heart, Throat, Third Eye, Crown.

fields.name: zodiac
fields.description: Filter by zodiac sign, case-insensitive. Valid values: aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces.

fields.name: element
fields.description: Filter by elemental association, case-insensitive. Valid values: Earth, Water, Fire, Air, Storm.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Filter by crystal color (partial match, case-insensitive). E.g., "pink", "green", "blue", "purple". Use GET /colors for valid values.

fields.name: planet
fields.description: Filter by planetary association (partial match, case-insensitive). E.g., "Venus", "Moon", "Jupiter". Use GET /planets for valid values.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum items to return per page. Range: 1-100, default 20.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default 0.
